payload.core_mechanism_summary: DP with 1D state: dp[v] = longest path ending at v. Process edges grouped by weight in increasing order, updating from previous dp values to avoid using equal weights.
payload.rationale: Solution uses a 1D array s, iterating weight groups ascending, updating s[to] = max(s[to], s[from]+1). No 2D state; explicit grouping avoids within-weight chaining.
